B21 prop:isom_strong at alpha=beta=0 (BTZ_1.tex:468-475), CLOSED, 0 sorry, no invariance of domain (CBG-REVIEW §2 route). Core: a box {r<eps1, |t-t0|<eps2} inside U, in log-polar coordinates a convex angle-shift-invariant B ⊆ C×R; (1) lift f|reg through the covering {r>0} -> reg E0 (mathlib IsCoveringMapOn.existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts, GX isCoveringMapOn_orbitMk_cylPos); (2) Liouville exists_smul_eq_on_of_isLocalHomeomorphOn: D∘f~ = g∘D; (3) one turn is a deck shift k, uniqueness of lifts, so gP = P^k g by rigidity of Isom(M3); (4) null coordinates: g preserves the fixed line Ru of P^k, is axis-preserving (GX.IsAxisAff: b(Lw)=b(w)/lam, lam>0), D^-1 g D is an explicit homeomorphism of the cylinder (GX.btzConj, GX.IsAxisAff.homeo; r -> r/lam, t -> (1/lam-lam) r + lam t + s0); (5) injectivity forces k = ±1 by the intermediate value theorem on the angle along one circle (GX.btzConj_winding, GX.e0BoxSec_orbit_ne); (6) descent to Aut(E0) (GX.btzE0Descend) and membership in G (GX.e0Lift_mem). k = -1 (theta -> -theta) is not excluded and need not be. The field's connectedness of U and 0 ≤ alpha0 are carried; the local core uses neither.

kb_proposals: LocalModel's Y for gx is Causal.Minkowski 2 ⊕ GX.BTZE0 (GX.E0Y), G = GX.e0Groupoid (a.e.-isomorphisms: pregroupoid with pointwise property E0RegAt), singY = GX.e0SingY (sing_0 = complement of support e0Atlas, sing_alpha = ∅ otherwise); field-type match with Causal.CBG.LocalModel.mk verified by elaboration.

Chart-independent membership in e0Groupoid: GX.mem_e0Groupoid_of_chart_eq (one pair of regular charts and one translation on the whole source) is the quickest way to put a concrete partial homeomorphism in G.
Any 'local-to-global' B2 statement for Y reduces, by GX.e0_eqOn_of_eqOn_open (rigidity propagation on a preconnected open set), to agreement with one element of G on one nonempty open set.

Lifting through the BTZ covering: GX.isCoveringMapOn_orbitMk_cylPos + mathlib IsCoveringMapOn.existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts on a convex box in log-polar coordinates (GX.e0BoxSec, GX.e0Box; Convex.contractibleSpace, IsOpen.locPathConnectedSpace) — no abstract universal cover needed.

An isometry g with gP = P^k g (k ≠ 0) is, in null coordinates, axis-preserving (GX.IsAxisAff), and D^-1 g D is an explicit homeomorphism of the cylinder (GX.btzConj): r -> r/lam, t -> (1/lam - lam) r + lam t + s0 — continuity at the axis needs only r and t, never theta (the natural topology of DInfty at the apex is {r < eps}).
B21 prop:isom_strong's 'injectivity forces l = 1' is the intermediate value theorem on the angle along one circle (GX.btzConj_winding): no invariance of domain, no normaliser classification.

Injectivity of [D⁻¹ ·] on a set S ⊆ {b > 0} of null coordinates: two points with one image differ by parab(2πk), which shifts c by 2πk·b. So [D⁻¹ ·] is injective on a ball of radius b(v₀)/2 (GX.e0TAInr_injOn), and on any S whose angle c/b ranges over less than 2π.

Chronology of Minkowski in null coordinates: (minkowski 2).lt ⊤ (nullToMink P) (nullToMink Q) ↔ 0 < (Q−P).b ∧ (Q−P).c² < (Q−P).a·(Q−P).b (GX.e0TA_minkowski_lt_iff; the same body as Causality's E0.NullConeLt).
Continuous r and t on BTZE0 without Causality: cylHomeomorph btz_two_pi_ne_zero ℝ (q y = (cplx y.1, y.2)), with DInfty.norm_cplx.

Causal.CBG.LocalModel.typeAgreement is FALSE for 𝕄 ⊕ 𝔼₀ (proved: GX.e0_not_typeAgreement_D). A piece winding once around the axis carries a second branch of f at a regular 𝔼₀ tip. The field holds at 𝕄 tips (no holonomy), and its convergence form (Tendsto instead of MapClusterPt) holds everywhere.

The P-invariants of null coordinates, b, nullQ = c² − ab, and the c-shift c ↦ c + 2πk·b, separate P-translates in explicit estimates (GX.e0CE_injOn). A set with |c| < b is a fundamental-domain piece for [D⁻¹ ·] (GX.e0TAInr_injOn_of_window).

To show that a concrete map is a local G-structomorphism on its whole domain, build one OpenPartialHomeomorph with source = the domain (GX.e0CEe) and prove E0RegAt pointwise via e0RegAt_of_exists from eventual chart equalities (GX.e0CE_regAt). No chart needs to be in the maximal atlas globally.
E0.Lt.of_polar (Causality) turns a global chronological relation of 𝔼₀ into a Minkowski one at nearby angles (|Δθ| ≤ π), which reads a diamond in a chart without any winding estimate (GX.e0TAD_diam).
